senses.zh_definition: 葆拉、保拉：通常用作女性名字的外来人名，具体中文译名依本人或既有译法确定。
senses.en_definition: A personal given name, predominantly feminine, derived from Latin Paula.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, lazimnya nama perempuan, yang berasal daripada nama Latin Paula.
senses.nuances: 默认按人名解释；原始语境缺失，无法确定具体人物。规范书写为 Paula，保留小写键仅为匹配输入。这里的马来语释义为编写释义，并非 DBP 原文；未核实其为马来语普通词，故不标为 official。排名仅沿用输入数据。姓名来源和跨语言读法见 [Behind the Name：Paula](https://www.behindthename.com/name/paula)。下列为自然的人名组合，不主张具有已验证的搭配频率。

etymology.historical_story: Paula belongs to a Roman naming tradition: it is the feminine counterpart of Paulus, a name associated with the Latin adjective meaning small. A fourth-century saint named Paula was a companion of Jerome. Its presence across European languages explains why the same spelling can have several pronunciations. These origins describe the name, not its bearer's personality. [Sources: Paula](https://www.behindthename.com/name/paula), [Paul](https://www.behindthename.com/name/paul).
